data.revised_prompt:
Create a single horizontal pixel-art sprite strip for the Codex app digital pet named 'tracebun' in the state 'failed'. Use the attached base pet/reference image as the canonical identity: a compact observability guardian rabbit with warm brown and cream colors, sturdy chibi silhouette, thick dark outline, tiny service badge on the chest, calm focused eyes, small floppy ears, and reliable engineer energy. Preserve the exact head shape, ear shape, limb shape, face design, markings, palette, outline weight, body proportions, prop/accessory design, and overall silhouette from the canonical pet. Only change pose/action for the 'failed' animation. Keep every frame recognizable as the same individual pet.

Important composition rules: exactly 8 separate frames arranged left-to-right in one row. Each frame must contain one complete, centered pose with safe padding, no cropping, no overlap, no slot crossing. Use the layout guide only for spacing and frame count, but do not include any guide pixels, boxes, borders, dividers, labels, lines, or backing. The final canvas background must be perfectly flat pure magenta #FF00FF edge-to-edge, with absolutely no white, off-white, gray, checkerboard, or transparency showing anywhere.

Animation direction: a subtle failed/error cycle for a tired but still cute pet, e.g. slight slump, blink, tiny wobble, small defeated sigh, brief head dip, ears droop a little, then recover to a neutral disappointed pose. Keep motion readable but minimal and consistent with sprite style. Do not redesign the character.

Style: clean pixel art sprite, high readability, compact proportions, dark outline, minimal shading, no text, no UI, no background objects, no special effects outside the character. Ensure the sprite fits nicely within each slot with consistent scale across all 8 frames.
